plan.title: RFQ vendor bid draft then submit

steps.note: Open the prepared event's buyer Responses screen as required for this state.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared live RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Enter the quote and save it as a vendor-side draft without submitting.

args.text: Your changes have been saved as draft.

steps.note: Confirm the vendor portal reports that the quote was saved as a draft.
Return to the buyer's Responses screen to inspect the response state.
Record the existing response visible in the prepared state; this demonstrates why the requested no-response assertion cannot be made.
Return to the vendor portal to submit the saved quote.
Reopen the RFQ pricing round before submitting the draft.
Submit the previously drafted quote at the requested price.
Confirm the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's Responses screen after submission.
Confirm the buyer has one visible response after submission, though the prepared baseline prevents proving that it newly appeared.
